capabilities: Show changed-file counts and commit status next to each repository in the file explorer
Stage and commit all changes from the file explorer with a prompted or auto-generated message
Pull and push to the remote, with scheduled auto-sync on startup or at set intervals
Open the system git diff tool for files and folders from the context menu
Highlight files with uncommitted changes and initialize new repositories
extras: Desktop-only; not compatible with mobile. Requires Obsidian v0.15.0+ and Git in the system PATH.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer shows no git information, so users cannot see uncommitted changes or pull/push state without leaving the vault.
summary: Git integration for the file explorer that shows commit status, sync state, and changed files next to each detected repository.
